title: The Ghost Dev
logline: A manager demands to know why his employee is missing standup, only to discover the employee quit months ago and an AI script took over.
hook: why is my old boss texting me?

messages.text: where are you? standup started at 9
this is your 3rd strike for rto
greg i don't work there anymore
very funny.
you literally pushed an update last night
and i approved your pto for friday
greg i quit in february
hr would have told me
if this is a tiktok prank i'm firing you
i sent you my resignation on feb 14
you sent an e-card that said 'it's not me it's u'
yeah that was my two weeks notice
are you serious.
because you are still on payroll
and you closed 42 tickets this month
oh wait
i forgot to turn off my python script
your what.
i automated my job last november
it's literally just chatgpt and a cron job
wait.
if a script is doing your job...
who did i just promote to senior dev?
LMFAOOOO
you promoted my script???
it had perfect attendance.
wait do i get its bonus
no.
it just put me on a pip.

cliffhanger: is the AI his manager now? 💀
